source: Northern Territory Government, Department of Resources — Field Guide to Pests, Beneficials, Diseases and Disorders of Mangoes (2nd edition), December 2010, ISBN 978-0-7245-7200-7
text:
Sooty blotch
Fungal, an unspecified fungus, possibly
Stomiopeltis sp.
Symptoms: Sparse superficial dark thread like fungal growth on shoot
terminals (stems and leaf petioles), leaves, fruit stalks and sometimes
on the fruit. Small dark brown blotches on leaves and young fruits.
Distribution: Most mango growing areas.
Favoured by: Rain, fog, irrigation and high humidity in warm weather.
